title: ChaosBench-Logic v2: Evaluating LLM Logical Reasoning over Dynamical Systems at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2605.24305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard accuracy on binary reasoning benchmarks hides critical failure modes: prior collapse, inconsistency under paraphrase, and inability to reason about parameter-dependent dynamics. We present ChaosBench-Logic v2, a 40,886-question benchmark over 165 dynamical systems with 27 FOL predicates and 78 axiom edges, together with CARE (Calibration- and Adversarial-Robust Evaluation), a protocol that surfaces these pathologies. Evaluating 14 models, we find that regime-transition reasoning remains near random (MCC = 0.05) even for frontier models, whereas FOL deduction with given premises reaches MCC = 0.52. Per-family decomposition shows that the proprietary-model advantage concentrates on cross-indicator (+0.40) and consistency tasks, while open-source Qwen 2.5-32B dominates indicator diagnostics (0.91 vs. 0.45). Two models exhibit negative MCC on bifurcation questions, confirmed as systematic anti-correlation via confusion-mat

translated_title: ChaosBench-Logic v2：大规模评估大语言模型在动力系统上的逻辑推理能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.24305v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：二元推理基准上的标准准确率会掩盖关键的失败模式：先验崩溃、释义下的不一致性，以及无法对参数依赖的动力系统进行推理。我们提出了ChaosBench-Logic v2，一个包含40,886道题目、覆盖165个动力系统、含27个一阶逻辑（FOL）谓词和78条公理边的基准，并同时提出CARE（校准与对抗鲁棒性评估）协议，该协议能够揭示上述病理现象。对14个模型的评估发现，即使是最前沿的模型，其状态转变推理仍接近随机水平（MCC = 0.05），而在给定前提下的FOL演绎推理可达到MCC = 0.52。按系统族的分解分析显示，专有模型的优势集中在跨指标（+0.40）和一致性任务上，而开源的Qwen 2.5-32B则在指标诊断任务上占据主导地位（0.91 vs. 0.45）。两个模型在分岔问题上表现出负MCC，并通过混淆矩阵被确认为系统性反相关。
tldr: 该论文提出了大规模动力系统逻辑推理基准ChaosBench-Logic v2和CARE评估协议，揭示了即使是最先进的LLM在状态转变推理上仍接近随机水平，并存在先验崩溃与释义不一致等系统性缺陷。
en_tdlr: ChaosBench-Logic v2 and the CARE evaluation protocol reveal that even frontier LLMs perform near random on regime-transition reasoning over dynamical systems, exhibiting systematic failure modes such as prior collapse and inconsistency under paraphrase.
